query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as count
            FROM users u
            LEFT JOIN friends f ON f.friend_id = u.id AND f.user_id = $1
            WHERE 
                u.id != $1
                AND (
                    u.username ILIKE $2 
                    OR u.email ILIKE $2 
                    OR u.first_name ILIKE $2 
                    OR u.last_name ILIKE $2
                )
                AND (
                    NOT u.is_private_profile 
                    OR f.friend_id IS NOT NULL
                )
